---
title: "Service"
---

As much as possible, I try to publish, review, and edit only for diamond or similar not-for-profit open access journals. I rarely turn down invitations to review papers in any of my research areas that come from non-profit journals.

I am currently a member of the scientific committee of the [Revista Española de Investigación Criminológica](https://reic.criminologia.net/index.php/journal/about/editorialTeam), the review board of the [Journal of Legal Research Methodology](https://www.northumbriajournals.co.uk/index.php/jlrm/about/editorialTeam), [Kriminologie - Das Online-Journal](https://www.kriminologie.de/index.php/krimoj/beirat), the [International E-Journal of Criminal Sciences](https://ojs.ehu.eus/index.php/inecs/about/editorialTeam), and the [ESRC Peer Review College](https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/guidance-for-reviewers/peer-review-college/).

At the University of Leeds, I am the Programme Leader of the [Quantitative Pathway](https://catalogue.leeds.ac.uk/Programme/202526?code=BS-LAW%2FCJCQ) for the BA in Criminal Justice and Criminology, a position I have held since 2019.

### Empirical Research on Sentencing (ERoS) Network

I co-founded and co-directed (from 2017 to 2024) [ERoS](https://empiricalresearchonsentencing.wordpress.com/), a network of empirical sentencing researchers, bringing together academics and public sector researchers. During that time I co-organised four online and in-person international symposia. The network is currently led by [Dr Mojca Plesničar](https://www.inst-krim.si/en/mojca-plesnicar/) and [Dr Jakub Drápal](https://www.prf.cuni.cz/en/detail-cloveka/1010944).
